title: "Quarto Test Site"

Before rendering, run `quarto add shelbylevel/slbrand` from inside this
directory to install the extension, matching how a real consumer project
would use it.

## Manual QA checklist

- [ ] Hover over logo — underline animation plays
- [ ] Toggle light/dark mode — rect cutout color updates to match navbar
- [ ] Resize to narrow/mobile width — logo scales down, no overflow
- [ ] Compare rendering in Safari vs. Arc/Chrome — should be pixel-identical
